say: I don't think God is real.
Because I've prayed for years... and He's never said a single word to me.
I go to church. I pray. I worship.
But no voice. No lightning. Nothing.
But what if God isn't silent... what if I was listening for the wrong thing?
Elijah waited for God in the wind... the earthquake... and the fire.
But God wasn't in any of them. He came... in a whisper.
So here's how you hear Him.
cap: So here's how you HEAR Him.

say: H is for History.
My faith doesn't stand on a feeling. It stands on an empty tomb, seen by over five hundred eyewitnesses.
cap: My faith doesn't stand on a feeling. It stands on an empty tomb, seen by 500+ eyewitnesses.

say: E is for Every page.
In nineteen forty-seven, scrolls found by the Dead Sea showed Isaiah, copied almost word for word, a thousand years older than any copy we had.
cap: In 1947, scrolls found by the Dead Sea showed Isaiah, copied almost word for word, 1,000 years older than any copy we had.

say: God kept His word. Read it out loud, and you're hearing His voice.
A is for Around you.
The friend who texted at the perfect moment. The sermon that felt aimed right at me.
God speaks through people... more than clouds.
R is for Rearview.
Look back... and you'll see one red thread through it all. His fingerprints. Everywhere.
He was never silent.
He's been whispering this whole time.
Which letter did you need today? Comment H, E, A, or R.
